reviews.note: Claimed fulfilment. North Korean deployments to Russia have been publicly reported since late 2024, so the base rate for this being news by Aug 2026 is high.
New claim. Names Rubio as the deceived party.
Reads a Camp David post as coded confirmation. Interpretation of a public post, not a forward claim.

Identifies the lead-encased object as drones and a dirty Russian item from Castro's era, and says it is alive. Sits alongside cold-war-briefcase-in-cuban-bunker, which called the same object a briefcase; the two descriptions do not agree.
Fuji named with mass casualties, plus Japan split down the middle.
News commentary on a Russian strike on Kyiv. No target was named in advance; nightly strikes on Kyiv are routine by this date.
Banter about Russia hitting delivery infrastructure. No dated or falsifiable content.
Turkey takes the strait and comes out as a vampire, given off Black Sea port strike reporting.
A clip of a woman objecting to a mosque in Japan, played for laughs. Not a claim he makes.
Prayer form. Asks that the president be surrounded by spirit-led rather than reprobate people.
A declaration calling for an uncovering. No named plot, place or date, so nothing here can fail.
New claim. Given in prayer form but stated as something he has seen.
Repeats it twice in the same prayer, with Netanyahu left in place until his time is done. The escape hatch is explicit: no date on when that time ends.
New claim. He asks what it means rather than interpreting, so nothing is committed.
New claim. He reassigns 41 from a storey to the forty first president in the same breath, which loosens the only specific detail in it.
New claim. Distinct from northeast-storm-tidal, which is a storm, and from east-coast-storm-newyork-to-miami; this one is named as a tsunami wave.
Recalls the September 2001 empty sky as the feeling America is about to have again. Implied rather than stated.
Fires and uncertainty alongside an ordinary sports season. Loose enough that an average American year would satisfy it.
Churches without room, people in the foyer, tied to a shaking across four continents.
New claim. Watch what God is about to do in Mexico, distinct from mexico-shaking.
Clips of candidates calling for a free Palestine. Commentary on footage, not his own word.
Adds Texas to the battleground list and treats a socialist leading there as the shaking he was shown. Cuts against ted-cruz-senate, which had the Texas seat going red.
Lindell resigns as chief executive to run full time. A step toward the claim, not the claim landing.
Kim comes out of the bunker as a social pariah. Kim has appeared publicly abroad repeatedly since 2024, so the bar is low.
Headlines about Russian strikes on Kyiv logistics sites, read as confirmation without an advance specific.
Vampire, war drums and the strait closing, restated off a Ukrainian strike on a Turkish vessel.
New claim. Oklahoma alone records thousands of small quakes a year, so a felt shaking there is close to certain regardless.
New claim. Same fire image he has used of Macron, given without an interpretation.
Same four banks plus BlackRock off to the side, matching the Clarity Act table a day earlier.
New claim. Third tulip image in the corpus, after tulip-youtube-money-transfer and alongside sushiswap-bridges-asia from the same week.
The codes and Chrome repeated. No referent given, so nothing here can be checked.
New claim. Crypto and tech consolidation is already the sector's default direction, which makes this hard to score as a hit.

Extends it to megachurches scanning congregations during worship, tied to address and social security number.
New claim. He corrects himself mid-sentence from Europe to Middle East. Directly against ebola-contained-not-egypt given three days earlier, which rules the Middle East out.
New claim. He states the meaning himself rather than leaving the image open.
A brown bear seen over California, matched afterwards to the state flag by his son. The match was found after the fact, not called in advance.
Prayer for prophetic accuracy rather than flakiness. Notable as self-directed, but nothing falsifiable.
Midnight hour urgency called over several continents. Prayer, not a dated claim.
Declares the outbreak will go away faster than it came. Prayer-conditional, and outbreaks of this kind usually do burn out, so containment on its own would not be a strong match.
Moves the Sharia warning onto Europe and Italy. Conditional on migration continuing.
New claim. Extends byron-florida-governor, but with maybe not this time, maybe next time attached, which removes any deadline.
The reprieve restated as a question about what is done with the time, alongside Oklahoma and Texas as battlegrounds.
Rebrand with no traction. He is calling a widely held read of her position rather than something contrarian.
Reads a headline about an Iran to Turkey call and says he wonders what comes of it. Explicitly not a claim.
New claim. Long range missile transfers to Ukraine have been debated publicly for two years, so this is close to the standing news position.
Iranian drones over Kuwait shot down. Commentary on live footage.
New claim. Specific weapon type and a ground invasion debate, which makes it unusually checkable for this corpus.
The new Israeli leader restated, with something wrong about the children that he says he will not touch.

Prayer form, asking that no grid or water cyber attack come near. Turns the standing claim into something that cannot fail either way.

A translation experience from Africa to the California coast. Testimony of the vision rather than added forward content.
